BiblicalUsage: The Hebrew word riqmâh means variegation of color; specifically, embroidery. It stands in 1 Chronicles 29:2, "…iron, and wood for of wood; onyx stones…", and in Ezekiel 16:10, "…clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put riqmâh here on purpose, and I take his word for it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
